description.text: Department of Business Management Department of business management is the first specialty in 60 years’ history. Till now, it has transported lots of special talented persons to the government , the industry and commerce ,the finance and other business units. In this department, there are 36% teachers are above associate profess .All-around teachers account for 40%. The teachers’ structure is reasonable and the teaching quality is high. This department exerts to raise senior special talented persons in the field of business management, the property circulation and international commerce.

duration.text: The Business Administration at Qingdao Hismile College is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
